exposure: Controlled delivery system of chitosan hydrogel loaded with selenium nanoparticles
cohort: 60 adult female rats with experimentally induced spinal cord injury at the thoracic vertebrae level.
finding: Local implantation of chitosan hydrogel loaded with selenium nanoparticles significantly reduced hemorrhage and inflammatory cells, promoted nerve fiber formation, and increased GFAP protein expression in rats with spinal cord injury, suggesting a neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effect.
